verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet platform, so integrating VLA or robotics foundation models into a robot's autonomy stack is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never documents any supported tooling for it. The AI-related items cover adjacent features only: an analytics AI assistant, plain-language fleet queries with ML-driven task recommendations, and generic agent/Cloud SDKs for telemetry and commands. None of these amounts to model integration into on-robot autonomy.
